instruction.name: xvftint.w.d
instruction.description: For each 128-bit lane, convert double-precision floating point elements in the corresponding lane of `a` into the upper half and elements in `b` into the lower half, as signed 32-bit integers, using current rounding mode specified in `fscr`.

latencies.notes: measured with a dependent chain. Unroll 20000, iters 500. Raw measurement was 5.00; the residual is a systematic calibration offset, so the recorded value is the nominal integer with the observed spread.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
